verdict.rationale: Context-Aware Access lets admins build app access policies on attributes including device security status, and Google endpoint management supplies the device-management layer (docs-28, docs-15, docs-17, docs-9). Community reports confirm users are actually blocked at login when device verification fails, but note that full enforcement depends on Chrome with the Endpoint Verification extension, which locks out Firefox users, and that diagnosing which policy denied access is painful. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the specific posture attributes the story names (managed, encrypted, screen-locked), cross-browser posture enforcement without Chrome/Endpoint Verification, and clear policy-denial diagnostics.
